about_the_game:
Dive into Terrors of War Demo, a free preview of Terrors of War, an Early Access RTS launching in July 2025. Lead your forces through intense WW2-inspired warfare, build your base, master the economy, and shape the battlefield in this solo dev passion project—ready up, the war effort needs you!

A World in Turmoil

This demo introduces Terrors of War, a strategic RTS set in an alternate WW2 fueled by secret experiments. Command sprawling bases, manage supply chains, and deploy tanks, infantry, and general powers like artillery strikes. The Early Access game, launching July 2025, will expand with unique factions, multiplayer, modding, and more—wishlist Terrors of War on Steam for details.

What’s in the Terrors of War Demo

This free demo delivers a 40–60 minute taste of Terrors of War’s strategic RTS gameplay, letting you command US forces:

  • Tutorial (30+ minutes): Master building your base, managing supply chains, commanding forces, and unleashing devastating general powers.

  • Skirmish Battle (20–25 minutes): Lead the USA against Germany in an action-packed skirmish map. Build a base, deploy tanks, infantry, and general powers to outmaneuver your enemy.

  • Customizable skirmish AI you can extend or recreate with the API and Lua.

What’s in the Early Access Game

This demo is a focused introduction to Terrors of War. The Early Access game, launching July 2025, will include:

  • Access to the German faction.

  • Introductory campaign phase.

  • 8 skirmish maps with highly customizable AI.

  • Experimental superweapons.

Support the War Effort!

Loved the demo? Share your feedback and wishlist Terrors of War on Steam to track the Early Access release. Your support fuels this solo dev’s mission to deliver an epic RTS—jump into the chaos today!

content_descriptors.notes: Frequent depictions of intense war violence, including soldier casualties, vehicle explosions, and building destruction.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4570 or AMD FX 8370
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTS 450 or AMD Radeon HD 6670
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended, HDD Supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 8700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1080 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended, HDD Supported

short_description: Step into a chaotic alternate history WW2 epic! Command vast armies and dominate with cunning tactics in pulse-pounding RTS battles. I'm a solo developer pouring my passion into this ambitious project—join the fight, share your feedback, and help the cause!
